capabilities.description: Build and certify interim payment certificates from the BOQ item rates and measured quantities, applying the contract retention rule and tracking claim status through approval.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

capabilities.description: Track elapsed time against the 730-day Time for Completion, accrue delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day capped at 10%, and track the defects notification period and performance security obligations.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.
Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that manages progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records and a document register, using the uploaded contract and BOQ as the single source of record. It serves the project's contracts, commercial, QA and document-control teams, tying every interim payment, delay-damages assessment and quality record back to the governing contract clauses and BOQ item rates.
